summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Edenor S.A., an Argentine electric utility, reporting the board's appointment of three members to its Audit Committee, including one designated as a financial expert. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management departure is involved.
